Alger, 6 septembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, September 6, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The UN General Assembly has adopted a resolution to generalize a more accurate cartographic representation of continent sizes. This text establishes the use of the "Equal Earth" projection to the detriment of the traditional Mercator map.
Un vote historique pour la projection «: A historic vote for the "Equal Earth" projection
L'Assemblée générale des Nations unies a: The United Nations General Assembly validated this text on Friday, September 4, 2026. It aims to correct the distortions of current world maps. Spearheaded by Togo and the African Union, and supported by France, the resolution received one hundred and sixty-four votes in favor. Only the United States voted against, while six countries abstained.
Le projet préconise l'adoption du modèle: The project advocates the adoption of the "Equal Earth" cartographic model. This system replaces the Mercator projection, designed in 1512 by the Flemish geographer Gerardus Mercator. The historical projection disproportionately enlarges areas located at high latitudes. This distortion visually diminishes the surface area of Africa, Latin America, and South Asia.
Le ministre des Affaires étrangères du T: The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Togo, Robert Dussey, defended a scientific and universal approach. According to him, maps influence education and collective perceptions. He believes it is necessary to offer an accurate representation to respect the dignity of peoples.
La représentante des États-Unis, Yaryna: The representative of the United States, Yaryna Ferencevych, denounced an ideological agenda. She regrets that the assembly is debating sixteenth-century concepts instead of addressing peace and prosperity.
Le ministre français des Affaires étrang: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot supported this initiative during a speech at the Sorbonne. He believes that correcting this cartographic distortion constitutes an act of truth.
Le texte est initié par le Togo et l'Uni: The text was initiated by Togo and the African Union, with the co-sponsorship of France.
Les États-Unis représentent l'unique vot: The United States represents the sole opposition vote against this cartographic reform project.
La projection « Equal Earth » est privil: The "Equal Earth" projection is favored to replace the historical Mercator map dating from 1512.
La projection de Mercator est critiquée: The Mercator projection is criticized for artificially minimizing the size of Africa, Latin America, and South Asia.
Le ministre togolais des Affaires étrang: Togolese Foreign Minister Robert Dussey maintains that this initiative promotes scientific rigor and the equal dignity of peoples.
Le ministre français des Affaires étrang: French Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot describes this correction as an exercise in historical truth.
